title: E.T.'s otherworldly success
summary: On this day in 1982 moviegoers met the lovable alien at the heart of Steven Spielberg's E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial. The emotional sci-fi hit opened to $11.8 million and became a box-office phenomenon, earning nearly $360 million domestically. It held the record as the highest-grossing film until Spielberg's Jurassic Park surpassed it in 1993.
